clue.text: Diving bird breathing with difficulty after losing tail

indicators.note: losing its tail means the word's final letter is dropped

parts.note: someone breathing with difficulty is puffing

explanation.surface: A seabird is left gasping for breath.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing tail' drops the last letter G from PUFFING.
explanation.definitionFit: The puffin is a seabird that dives underwater to catch fish.

clue.text: Put 25 bet on dog's hairstyle

indicators.note: in a down entry one piece placed on another sits above it

parts.note: in British slang a pony is a sum of twenty-five pounds, a common stake
to dog someone is to tail or follow them

explanation.surface: A gambler stakes money on a dog, then turns to hairdressing.
explanation.walkthrough: PONY is British slang for £25; 'on' puts it above TAIL in this down entry. The '25' is not a cross-reference to 25-across.
explanation.definitionFit: A ponytail is a hairstyle with hair gathered and tied at the back of the head.

clue.text: Be confronted by rise in cosmetic surgery

parts.note: to face something is to be confronted by it
a lift is a rise or raising

explanation.surface: Someone facing a rise in demand for cosmetic procedures.
explanation.definitionFit: A facelift is a cosmetic operation that tightens the skin of the face.

clue.text: One awful leading article names place in Nigeria

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
awful means bad

indicators.note: the first letter of the word it picks from

parts.note: the indefinite article a, taken as the article that leads
N is an abbreviation for name

explanation.surface: A dreadful newspaper editorial names a Nigerian location.
explanation.definitionFit: Ibadan is a large city in south-western Nigeria.

clue.text: Somersault a complete failure in rubber-soled sandal

parts.note: a flip is a somersault in the air
a flop is a complete failure

explanation.surface: An acrobat's somersault goes badly wrong in cheap beach footwear.
explanation.definitionFit: Flip-flops are light sandals with a rubber sole held on by a thong between the toes.

clue.text: A mere reddish colouring

explanation.surface: A pool of water with a reddish tint.
explanation.definitionFit: A mere is a stretch of still water; lake is also a crimson pigment made from dye fixed on a base.

clue.text: Father joins son and samples cakes

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
S is the genealogy abbreviation for son
to sample is to try, so samples gives tries

explanation.surface: Dad and his boy taste the baked goods together.
explanation.definitionFit: Pastries are small sweet baked items, here called cakes.

clue.text: Chance a short visit

explanation.surface: A brief call made on the off chance.
explanation.definitionFit: A look-in is an opportunity to take part, and also a quick call at someone's home.

clue.text: Hire piano first if you would be so kind

definitions.text: if you would be so kind

indicators.note: first says this piece comes before the other

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly
to hire property is to lease it

explanation.surface: A request to rent a piano before anything else, politely made.
explanation.definitionFit: The polite word added to a request stands for 'if you would be so kind'.

clue.text: Almost kiss sailor providing heavenly stuff to drink

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of the word is left off

parts.note: to neck is to kiss and cuddle
a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor nearly gets a kiss along with a divine drink.
explanation.definitionFit: In myth, nectar was the drink of the gods.

clue.text: They run through snow then stride on the piste

parts.note: skis are runners that glide over snow
to lope is to move with long strides

explanation.surface: A skier glides and then strides along the run.
explanation.definitionFit: A piste is a prepared run of snow for skiing.

clue.text: Old left, old right, school love sherry

annotationWithheld.why: Old left, old right, school love sherry: O+L+O+R+S+O gives only six letters of OLOROSO, one O short; no reading of the held words supplies the seventh letter and no blog or reprint was found
annotationWithheld.clue: Old left, old right, school love sherry

clue.text: Poorly placed in the listing could be ploughed

indicators.note: placed in says one word is set inside another

parts.note: a table is a listing of items in rows
poorly means ill

explanation.surface: Something badly ranked in a list turns out to be farmable.
explanation.definitionFit: Land that can be tilled is land suitable for ploughing.

clue.text: Wiring up candelabra in some premises requires intelligence

indicators.note: premises are buildings that house something, here letters held across the words

explanation.surface: Fitting a chandelier in a building needs some cleverness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'premises' tells you the words house the answer: candelaBRA IN Some.
explanation.definitionFit: Brains is an informal word for cleverness or mental ability.

clue.text: Support bridge player and partner

parts.note: East is one of the four players at bridge, abbreviated E
a spouse is a marriage partner

explanation.surface: Backing a card player and their partner at the bridge table.
explanation.definitionFit: To espouse a cause is to adopt and support it.

clue.text: Broadcast if no news?

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered about, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A question whether there is nothing to report on air.
explanation.definitionFit: Info is short for information, which here stands for news.

clue.text: Gamble about the danger in some meat

indicators.note: about means one word goes round another

parts.note: a gamble is a bet
a risk is a danger

explanation.surface: Betting on the hazards found in some meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Brisket is a cut of beef from the breast.

clue.text: Harm Nato perhaps with long-running task

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters might be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: Damaging NATO turns into a drawn-out job.
explanation.definitionFit: A marathon is a long race, and by extension any long and tiring undertaking.

clue.text: Book genre offering excitement to elderly readers initially

parts.note: a thrill is a burst of excitement

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of each of the words it follows

explanation.surface: A kind of novel that gives older readers a buzz.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes E and R from 'elderly readers'.
explanation.definitionFit: A thriller is a type of novel full of suspense.

clue.text: Sent down with "E"-level in theological degree

indicators.note: in places one word inside the other

parts.note: DD stands for Doctor of Divinity, a degree in theology
an E-level is a grade E, spelled out as E GRADE

explanation.surface: Someone expelled with a poor mark from a divinity course.
explanation.definitionFit: To be degraded is to be lowered in rank, which is what sent down means.

clue.text: Graduates in a minute will produce a woodwind instrument

parts.note: BAs are holders of the Bachelor of Arts degree
in a minute means soon

explanation.surface: New graduates will shortly produce a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: The bassoon is a large double-reed instrument of the woodwind family.

clue.text: Buzz off',said card holder in casino

indicators.note: said means the word is spoken and gives one of the same sound

parts.note: shoo is what you say to tell someone to buzz off

explanation.surface: A croupier tells someone to get lost at the gaming table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'said' gives the word sounding like SHOO.
explanation.definitionFit: In a casino the shoe is the box that holds the decks for dealing.

clue.text: Meat for every picnic carrier

parts.note: ham is a kind of meat
per means for each or every

explanation.surface: Cold meat for everyone packed into the basket.
explanation.definitionFit: A hamper is a wicker basket for carrying a picnic.

clue.text: Girl on time in Bordeaux

indicators.note: in a down entry one piece placed on another sits above it

parts.note: Clare is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A young woman arrives punctually in a French city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bordeaux' looks like the place but is the wine; 'on' puts CLARE above T in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Claret is the British name for red wine from the Bordeaux region.

clue.text: Is able to imitate savoury accompaniment to drink

parts.note: can means is able
to ape is to imitate

explanation.surface: Copying a snack served with cocktails.
explanation.definitionFit: A canapé is a small savoury bite served with drinks.

clue.text: On board a launch

parts.note: to float a company is to launch it on the stock market

explanation.surface: Aboard a newly launched boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'launch' suggests a boat, but here it is the launch of a company, a float.
explanation.definitionFit: Being afloat means being at sea, aboard a ship.

clue.text: Arrange please to include one with right support for climbing plant

indicators.note: to include means one piece is taken inside another
to arrange is to put in a new order, so the letters of the word are reshuffled

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A gardener politely asks for a trellis for a climbing plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arrange' turns PLEASE into ESPALE; 'to include' puts I in it, giving ESPALIE; then R is added.
explanation.definitionFit: An espalier is a trellis or frame on which fruit trees and shrubs are trained flat.

clue.text: Signal left inside reveals what this is

indicators.note: inside means one piece is set within the other

parts.note: a cue is a signal to act

explanation.surface: A signal reveals what the puzzle line itself is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' puts L in CUE; the definition points at the line you are reading.
explanation.definitionFit: The words you are reading are the hint that leads to an entry.

clue.text: Left gap from which one may observe the sea

definitions.text: from which one may observe the sea

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
a hole is a gap

explanation.surface: A gap on the left of a ship giving a view of the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A porthole is the round window in a ship's side for looking out.

clue.text: Front of nappy was poorly fixed

indicators.note: front of picks the first letter of the word that follows

parts.note: to be poorly is to be ill, so was poorly means ailed

explanation.surface: The front of a baby's nappy was badly fastened.
explanation.definitionFit: To nail something is to fix it, so nailed means fastened in place.

clue.text: Street in France can go in with groups of followers

annotationWithheld.why: Street in France can go in with groups of followers: RUE with TIN inside gives RTINUE, and no held word supplies the E or the S of RETINUES; no blog or reprint was found
annotationWithheld.clue: Street in France can go in with groups of followers

clue.text: Brought up in the end by the editor

indicators.note: by means one piece is set beside the other

parts.note: the rear is the back end
ED is the abbreviation for editor

explanation.surface: Raised at the back by the newspaper's editor.
explanation.definitionFit: To be reared is to be raised as a child, a synonym of brought up.
